title: 305th Bomb Group - B17 Flying Fortress (42-97578) Crash
memorial_details: Wall mounted, landscape orientated incised stone tablets, enclosed by a moulded stone frame. Inscription infilled with black paint.
inscription: WORLD WAR 1939-1945. / REMEMBER / SERGEANT CHARLES HENRY HILTON, / ROYAL AIR FORCE, OF YELDEN. / KILLED ON ACTIVE SERVICE / 24TH AUGUST 1943 / (CHILD'S NAME), AGED 14 YEARS. / (CHILD'S NAME), AGED 4 YEARS / OF YELDEN. / KILLED BY AN AIRCRAFT WHICH CRASHED / NEAR THIS CHURCH 24TH MARCH 1944. In memory o the men who died on the night of 24th March 1944 when Boeing B-17G Flying Fortress serial number 42-97578 of 422nd Squadron 305th Bomb Group crashed just north of Yelden Church. Aircrew (names) 1121st Quartermaster Company (names)
community_connection: Civilian casualties: Aged 14 Years, Aged 4 Years. Of Yelden
